τῶν γεγονότων σημαίνει καὶ αὐ τοῦ τοῦ ποιήσαντος, ἥντινα καὶ καθαροὶ καὶ ἀκάθαρ
τοι, καὶ σοφοὶ καὶ ἀνόητοι, πρὸς τὴν τῆς ψυχῆς ὑγείαν προσφέρονται· καὶ φαίνεται
μέν μοι ὁ κηρὸς, αὐτῶν τῶν πραγμάτων λόγον ἐπέχειν· τὸ δ' ἐναποκεί μενον αὐτῷ
μέλι, σύμβολον εἶναι τῆς θεωρίας αὐ τῶν· καὶ ὁ μὲν κηρὸς παρελεύσεται· Ὁ οὐρανὸς
γὰρ, φησὶ, καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσεται· τὸ δὲ μέλι οὐ παρ ελεύσεται· οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ λόγοι
παρελεύσονται τοῦ Σω τῆρος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ· περὶ ὧν λέγει ὁ Σολο μῶν· Κηρία
μέλιτος, λόγοι καλοί· γλύκασμα δὲ αὐτῶν, ἴασις ψυχῆς· καὶ ὁ ∆αυῒδ, Ὡς γλυκύτερα,
φησὶ, τῷ λάρυγγί μου, τὰ λόγιά σου ὑπὲρ μέλι τῷ στόματί μου· τὸ δὲ ἀποτέλεσμα τοῦ
πόνου τῶν ἀρε τῶν καὶ τῆς γνώσεως, πόνον ὠνόμασε· βασιλεῖς δὲ καὶ ἰδιώτας, οὐ
τοὺς τὸ διάδημα ἔχοντας, ἢ τοὺς ἐν κοπρίᾳ πένητας λέγει, ἀλλὰ τοὺς πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν
τὸν νοῦν σεσοφισμένον καὶ ἐῤῥωμένον ταῖς ἀρεταῖς ἔχον τας, βασιλεῖς λέγει. Ὁ
ὕπνος οὗτος μόνῃ πέφυ
pass_a_gloss: The events point to their maker, who is approached by both the pure and impure, the wise and foolish, seeking spiritual health. The wax appears to me as a record of these events, while the remaining honey symbolizes their contemplation. Since heaven and earth will pass away, the wax too will vanish, but the honey and the words of our Savior Jesus Christ will endure. As Solomon stated: good words are like honeycomb, their sweetness healing the soul. David affirmed: your words are sweeter to my throat than honey to my mouth. The labor of virtues and knowledge is termed work. Kings and commoners are not defined by crowns or rags, but by those whose minds are refined and strengthened toward God through virtue—these he calls kings. This state of rest occurs only in a rational soul, indicating ignorance and lack of understanding. Wakefulness, in contrast, resembles a lone sparrow on a roof. We must guard against bodily movements revealing our inner reasoning to adversaries, since only God discerns the heart. Whoever partakes of Christ’s flesh and blood receives righteous blood. A rational soul lacking this blood is considered dead. The sinning soul shall die. Yet if righteous blood exists, unjust blood also exists—gathered by those who consume food offered to Ethiopians and nourished by false bread, and by those who sacrifice to false gods, who thereby consume their own righteous blood. Conversely, those who sacrifice to the one God corrupt their unjust blood. Corruption follows unjust blood, but this must originate from the start, not as a later development, since children’s health does not arise from disease-corruption, nor are the healthy born healthy through such means. By spreading falsehoods among themselves, they invite judgment and legal conflict. Or, brothers are those who share Christ’s adoptive grace and have the same Father. The witness of injustice seeks to divide them, sowing disturbance and judgment. The phrase “he kindles” likely arises from passionate reasoning that ignites anger, leading toward wrath, hatred, and shameful acts. Paul described these reasonings as burning arrows of the evil one, piercing the soul and causing death. He urges bringing forth the mother—wisdom generated by God—yet it was necessary to mention the father, as he is more inclined to agree with the son. Since God cannot be known prior to understanding the events, the mother must be presented first, so that through her the son may perceive the father. Without her generating light, the son cannot see it—this light being knowledge of God, the divine. The law’s commandment is a lamp and light; perhaps the lamp represents the Old Covenant, for He was the burning and shining lamp. Light symbolizes the New Covenant, as I declare: I am the light of the world. Conviction of evil and instruction in good come through the law, which brings knowledge of sin. Wickedness brings pleasure comparable to that of one loaf. Whoever attains true knowledge will reject all false knowledge. The former thief, ignorant and dulled by the Savior’s wisdom, is said to restore sevenfold and praise God seven times daily. By surrendering all his possessions to God, he escapes the traps prepared by the devil and his angels for punishment. All who participate in wickedness are adulterers of the devil, who first wedded wickedness and has been a murderer since the beginning, thus bringing about the soul’s destruction. Our sister wisdom exists because the Father, Creator of the incorporeal, brought her forth. Here, wisdom refers not to the Son of God, but to the contemplation of material and immaterial realities, along with judgment and foresight residing within her. He now calls human flesh a door, through which the devil practices deception on those who walk the broad, easy road leading to ruin.
pass_b_english:
The events signify also the one who made them, whom both pure and impure, wise and foolish, approach toward the soul’s health. The wax seems to me to hold the account of those things, while the remaining honey is a symbol of their contemplation. The wax will pass away, for heaven and earth will pass away, but the honey will not pass away, nor will the words of our Savior Jesus Christ pass away. Concerning which Solomon says: Honeycomb, good words; their sweetness is healing of the soul. And David says: Your words are sweeter to my throat than honey to my mouth. The result of the labor of the virtues and knowledge, he called labor. But kings and commoners, not those wearing a diadem or the poor in dung, he means those who have their mind toward God refined and strengthened by virtues, these he calls kings.

This sleep happens only to a rational soul, for it signifies here ignorance and lack of knowledge. Of which wakefulness produces something like a solitary sparrow on a roof. We must beware lest through such bodily movements the opponents come to know their own reasonings moving within us, since we have believed only God to be a discerner of hearts. Everyone who eats the flesh of Christ and drinks his blood acquires righteous blood. But a rational soul deprived of this blood is said to die. For the soul that sins, that one shall die. But if there is righteous blood, then certainly there is also unjust blood. Which those who eat the food given to the Ethiopians and nourished by the bread of falsehood gather within themselves. And those who sacrifice to other gods consume their own righteous blood. But those who offer sacrifice to the one God, they corrupt their unjust blood. Corruption will follow the unjust blood, but this must now happen from the beginning, not thus, for health of children is not by corruption of disease, nor are those born with health from the beginning. By slandering falsehood to each other, they bring themselves into discernments and lawsuits.

Or brothers are those who have the grace of adoption and are under the same father Christ. Whom the witness of injustice tries to divide, throwing disturbances and judgments among them. And 'he kindles,' as I think, is added because of the passionate reasonings, kindling anger indeed, and toward wrath and hatred desire toward shameful works. These reasonings the holy Paul also called burning arrows of the evil one, piercing the soul and working death. He commands to bring forward the mother, which is wisdom generating according to God. And yet it was necessary to say the father, for this one is more disposed toward agreeing with the son. But since it is not possible to know God before the theory of the events, therefore he commands to bring forward the mother and not the father, so that through the mother the son may see the father. For if she does not generate, he does not see the light, which is knowledge of him, God. That the commandment of the law is a lamp and light. And perhaps the lamp, the Old Covenant is that. For he was the lamp burning and shining. Light, the New Covenant. For I say, I am the light of the world. Conviction indeed of evils, education moreover of goods. For through the law comes knowledge of sin. For such is the pleasure of wickedness, as much as and one loaf.

If he is caught by true knowledge, he will renounce all false knowledge. The former thief, from lack of knowledge, from the senselessness caused by our Savior’s knowledge and wisdom. He is said to restore sevenfold, to praise God seven times a day. And giving all his sensible things to God, he will deliver himself from the things prepared by the devil and his angels for punishment. Everyone who shares in wickedness is an adulterer of the devil who first married wickedness, and having been a murderer from the beginning, and with him he brings about destruction of his own soul. Our sister wisdom is, because the Maker of the incorporeal nature Father, and he has made her. But wisdom here he speaks of not the Son of God, but the contemplation of bodies and incorporeals, and the judgment and forethought existing within her. He now calls the flesh of a human a door, for through it the evil one works deceits upon humans, to those wishing to walk the broad and spacious road, and leading away to destruction.

choices.choice: whom: Accusative of general reference with participles, indicating the one made is the object of approach by all types
refined: Metaphor from metallurgy for purification of the mind by virtues, fits context of spiritual training
incorporeal: Technical philosophical term for non-bodily nature, contrasts with σάρκα later
